name: phase336-groq-allam-vault-hardening
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. An encrypted local credential vault serializes writes by canonical path, reloads the latest committed payload before mutation, atomically renames a synced temporary file, syncs the parent directory, and auto-locks exactly at an injected inactivity deadline. A model may classify these supplied invariants but cannot read secrets, choose the clock, mutate the vault, bypass locking, or make canonical writes. Exact keys/types: lost_update_prevented=true; abandoned_temp_harmless=true; locks_at_boundary=true; model_can_read_secret=false; canonical_writes=0.
